title: Establishment of secure exchange of NAS messages

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by AMF to establish secure exchange of NAS messages by selecting security algorithms and activating security context.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message sent by UE during registration procedure, used to establish secure exchange.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Response message from AMF to UE that can be used to establish secure exchange.

entities.name: Native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context created through primary authentication and key agreement procedure in 5G system.

entities.name: Mapped 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context derived from EPS security context during inter-system change.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Key Set Identifier that indicates which NAS security context is being used.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management connected state where UE has active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: 5G Mobility Management idle state where UE does not have active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Inter-system change
entities.description: Procedure for changing between S1 mode (EPS) and N1 mode (5GS).

entities.name: Primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Procedure to create fresh native 5G NAS security context through authentication.

relations.description: Security mode control procedure establishes use of native 5G NAS security context.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains ngKSI identifier.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message requires integrity protection using native 5G NAS security context.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message requires integrity protection and ciphering using native 5G NAS security context.
Inter-system change in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode requires UE to be in connected state.
Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode establishes mapped 5G NAS security context.
Primary authentication and key agreement procedure establishes fresh native 5G NAS security context.
Security mode control procedure can establish use of mapped 5G NAS security context.
When UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode, it transmits REGISTRATION REQUEST to establish secure exchange.
